title: Primary-source review of IDEA000014 and IDEA000013
method: Programmatic SHA-256 and line extraction from the primary reports/methods; route-check and lookup performed for GDT760, GDT702, GDT703, GDT763, and GDT804.

reviews.question: Does an amount frame bind exactly one measured entity?

quotes.text: Die Mengenmenge ist vollständig und mechanisch definiert: ... zusammen 281 Ausdrücke auf 98 bereits im Cache vorhandenen Seiten. ... Die sieben GDT759-Grenzbrücken zählen nicht als unabhängige Zeugen.

Für jeden Mengenausdruck werden genau der unmittelbar linke und rechte Platz betrachtet. ... Ein exakter Stoff-/Zubereitungskontakt erzeugt eine einmalige Mengenphrase; zwei Kontakte am selben Ausdruck bleiben als bilateral mehrdeutig sichtbar.

Die ursprünglich geplante Regel „Zutat steht links von der Menge“ ist falsch. ... Das ist keine allgemeine Sprachwortstellung. Es ist eine unmittelbar ausführbare Readerregel für genau diese Mengenformen.
Wasser und Wein treffen dieselben sechs Feuchtfamilien-Stellen. ... Sechs Trockenstoffkontakte sind mit Pulver vereinbar, identifizieren aber keines der Wörter als Pulver.

reviews.assessment: GDT760 independently supplies a complete amount-expression census and bounded immediate-neighbor contacts, but its MATERIAL/PREPARATION axes and whole-word candidates are inherited working annotations, not independent measured-entity gold bindings. Therefore the one-to-one conservation hypothesis is not entailed by GDT760; it adds a new constraint requiring independently annotated amount, entity multiplicity, and coordination.

later_correction.quote: Das sind **keine automatisch lizenzierten Inhaltsplätze**: Keine der fünfzehn ausgewählten Mittelformseiten war in GDT760 bereits ein sauberer CONTENT_PREP-Kontakt. ... Damit fällt der behauptete einheitliche Stoffslot weg.
later_correction.implication: GDT804 corrects any assumption of a universal amount-side content slot, but does not test or establish one-to-one amount/entity conservation.

reviews.recommendation: Retain raw as a conditional quantitative proposal only. First freeze independent entity multiplicity and coordination labels; do not describe GDT760's 45 contacts as independent measured-entity bindings.

reviews.question: Does an operation predict a result/state within two fields?

quotes.text: The census asks for one occurrence-bound C012 link without generalizing adjacency, action surface, or morphology.
The prior result label is current graph state, not independent semantic evidence; a result-state candidate identifies no producing action.
Eleven target actions yield seven nominal blocks, three further actions, one line end, and one exact written result.
The relation is occurrence-bound; it is not an action-output rule and not externally confirmed plaintext.

reviews.independent_binding: no for the proposed general latency claim; partial/occurrence-bound for one relation
reviews.assessment: GDT702 supports one tightly bounded action-to-written-result relation, but explicitly refuses an action-surface or general adjacency rule. It does not entail a universal two-field result latency: an operation may have an implicit, delayed, or cross-record result, and the existing result label is partly inherited working state.

later_correction.quote: None has a reader-exact `PROCESS`, `PASS`, or `CLOSE` role within three slots on either side. ... A residue remains imaginable, but it is no longer a sensible default.
later_correction.implication: GDT763 directly narrows result claims by rejecting a local process-close expectation, while retaining a content/record-field interpretation. GDT703 broadens the census to 83 action clauses but still counts only seven finished-state firsts; it is a coverage extension, not support for a fixed two-field latency.

reviews.recommendation: Repair the proposal before selection: replace the fixed two-field prediction with an explicitly bounded, occurrence-level result relation, or preregister alternative latency scopes. Do not use failure of the two-field threshold as a falsifier of operation semantics.

overall: Both ideas remain raw. GDT760 provides quantitative opportunity and position-conditioned contacts, not independent entity binding. GDT702 provides one occurrence-bound relation and explicitly blocks generalization; GDT763 is the key later narrowing correction for result claims.
